packageRules.description: Record the most precise upstream version in the comment next to a digest-pinned action. Equivalent to helpers:pinGitHubActionDigestsToSemver, but with extractVersion relaxed so major-only tags like v21 still match (the official preset's ^v?\d+\.\d+\.\d+$ skips actions that never tag a patch release).
Open pinDigest (initial SHA pinning) PRs immediately: a Renovate bug leaves them pending forever under minimumReleaseAge.

description: Update dependencies every Monday 9am-5pm JST. Inlined from the org-private renovate-supply-chain preset for issue #9: pins GitHub Action references to digests and holds every update for 7 days. The preset's exception for jubilee-works/timetree-github-actions actions was dropped because this repository uses no such actions.
